svg.title: BR Core 5V bus distribution
svg.desc: The 5V bus splits three ways: an unswitched feed straight to the processor layer, shown as a single long arrow with no switch in the path, and two software-enabled load switches limited to 1.6 amps each that report faults, one for serial 1 and one for the general peripherals. All three pass through a filter clamping at 5.5 volts before leaving the power layer.
